'''Lohjoy''' was a [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who served aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Omen]]''<ref name="LTotS" /> in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> at the onset of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. During that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], while the [[Sith dreadnaught]]s ''Omen'' and [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] were carrying [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber-amplifying]] [[Lignan crystal]]s to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], the two ships were [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|ambushed]] by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] over the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phaegon III]]. While Lohjoy was transmitting a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] to ''Omen''{{'s}} [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Yaru Korsin]], an explosion in the starship caused her [[Snake/Legends|snake]]-like Ho'Din [[Hair/Legends|hair]] to catch on fire; she was subsequently [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Hull/Legends|hull]] breach. Commander Korsin described Lohjoy as honest and cautious.<ref name="LTotS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lohjoy appeared in the [[2009]] [[eBook]] ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]'', written by [[John Jackson Miller]].<ref name="LTotS" />
